verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI's own docs list automated pull request reviews that give contextual feedback and suggestions, and a community user reports it catching bugs that reviewers missed. However, no evidence shows the review is triggered automatically on every pull request, or how the GitHub integration is set up and configured. missing for 10: documented automatic triggering on every PR, setup/configuration docs for the PR review workflow, deeper independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get automatic code review with contextual feedback on every pull request

citations.quote: Pull Request Reviews: Automated code review with contextual feedback and suggestions
Gemini is consistently offering better code review tips. It has officially caught multiple potential bugs, even a few that reviewers might have missed.
